propositions: executor.py at 790 LOC exceeds available headroom against the 800-LOC hard cap and requires splitting to preserve modularity

The call graph reveals two independent clusters: the step-kind I/O contract model (declaration and static compatibility) and the run engine (control flow, dispatch, recording) with no internal call edges between them

The contract cluster (StepContract, STEP_CONTRACTS, contract_for, input_schema_for, shallow_contract_check and helpers) must move to a new step_contracts.py module while executor.py re-exports public symbols to preserve all existing import points unchanged

The split must preserve behaviour such that all existing tests pass without modification and must leave real headroom (target 100-500 LOC per file, executor ~655 LOC and step_contracts ~190 LOC after split)
